Notes: The Archmastery tutorial arena (Magic: The Archmastering, WC-PreCel-MAIN-001). Its two doorways, 'Teleport location 8' (-8, -6191) and 'Teleport location 9' (3, 6165), have no destination in the zone files, so the Exit sends both back out to Unicorn Way in front of the Arena door, where the Duel Arena's own exits land (2456, 1651), so you can talk to Diego the Duelmaster again for the last step.
